crit.assistant_request: a question or request for the voice assistant (information, explanation, alarm, reminder, music, volume, translation, a story or joke)
crit.backchannel: an acknowledgement or filler: uh-huh, okay, I see, got it, oh really, hmm, laughter
crit.someone_else: talking to a family member or someone nearby: calling them by name or title (mom, dear, honey), asking them to do something, telling them what the speaker is about to do, or on a phone call
crit.noise: a cough, throat clearing, or meaningless noise
